projects.name: Ariadne: On-Call Agent with Graph Memory
bullets: Agent Design: Built an on-call agent over a FalkorDB graph with nine graph tools; Cypher and graph algorithms rank the suspect commit while the LLM only chooses tools and explains, so the verdict is unchanged without the model.

projects.name: AgriN: Digital Agriculture Advisory Network
bullets: Deterministic Engine: FAO-56 evapotranspiration, soil and paddy water balance, nutrients and crop rotation are computed by code; the LLM only narrates, and a guard rejects any figure that is not in the engine output.

projects.name: Jal Panchayat: Village Water Safety Verdicts
projects.sub: Code for a Billion · Personal Project
bullets: Fail-Closed Engine: Deterministic IS 10500 verdict engine over 16 water-quality parameters that reports untested water as unknown, never safe; 19 property tests.
